crossRefs.note: So Satan went out from the presence of Yahweh, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.
He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.

My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.
He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.
My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.

translations.web: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.
translations.bsb: My flesh is clothed with worms and encrusted with dirt; my skin is cracked and festering.
translations.kjv: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.
translations.asv: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; My skin closeth up, and breaketh out afresh.
